title: The editor, reading
logline: The editor at the drafting table with Box 21 open, reading the first private page, from behind — a coat the page draws as a coat, hair the page draws as hair, nothing else. The one gridded page is three box-days away; this is the day before the form was wanted.

panels.composition: A visitor from behind in a good coat at a drafting table with a cardboard box open beside them reading a sheet under the lamp, a man's plaid shoulder at the frame's edge, an old three-legged dog watching from a bed by the door.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a visitor in a good coat seen from behind at a drafting table with a cardboard box open beside them reading a sheet under a lamp, a man's plaid shoulder at the frame's edge and an old three-legged dog watching from a bed by the door, no words legible
image.notes: The editor: never a face. Compare ro_2026-10-14.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
